about.metaDescription: Why BondCheck exists, where its data comes from and how it keeps your bond list private.
about.title: About BondCheck
about.lead: BondCheck helps people in Pakistan find out whether their prize bonds have won, and keeps an eye on gold and rupee rates for them.

sections.heading: Why we built it
paragraphs: Millions of prize bonds are held in drawers and envelopes, and prizes go unclaimed because nobody checked an old draw. Checking by hand means reading long lists published every few weeks for each denomination.
BondCheck checks a number against every draw we hold in one step, and keeps checking on every new draw if you add the bond to your list.

sections.heading: What makes it different
paragraphs: Results come from the official National Savings files wherever they exist, and every draw page shows where its list came from. When two sources disagree we say so on the page instead of picking one quietly.
There is no account and no tracking. The site works in English and Urdu, on slow connections, and offline for pages you have already opened.

sections.heading: What it is not
paragraphs: BondCheck is not a bank, a broker or a government service, and it does not buy or sell bonds. Prizes are claimed only through National Savings and authorised bank branches. Always confirm a win with an official source.

data.metaDescription: Where BondCheck gets prize bond results, gold, silver and currency rates, how often they update and how they are checked.
data.title: Data sources and attribution
data.lead: Every figure on BondCheck comes from a named source. This page lists them, explains how we check them and gives the credit their licences ask for.

nss.name: National Savings Pakistan (Central Directorate of National Savings)
nss.role: Official draw result files, draw schedules and the official list of past draw dates. This is our primary source.

pkprizebond.name: pkprizebond.com
pkprizebond.role: Historical full result lists from 2000 to 2023, from an archived copy. Used only where no official file exists.

prizeinfo.name: prizeinfo.net
prizeinfo.role: First and second prize records, draw numbers and cities, used to cross-check other sources.

goldapi.name: gold-api.com
goldapi.role: Spot prices for gold, silver, platinum and palladium in US dollars per troy ounce.

erapi.name: ExchangeRate-API
erapi.role: Daily reference exchange rates for over 160 currencies.

fawaz.name: Free Currency Exchange Rates API by Fawaz Ahmed
fawaz.role: Historical daily exchange rates (public domain, CC0).

sbp.name: State Bank of Pakistan
sbp.role: Published interbank rates for the Pakistani rupee.

fap.name: Forex Association of Pakistan
fap.role: Open market buying and selling rates for foreign currency in Pakistan.

app.name: Associated Press of Pakistan, reporting the All Pakistan Sarafa Gems and Jewellers Association
app.role: Daily reported gold rates per tola and per 10 grams in Pakistan.

checks: Every bond number must have six digits, appear once per draw and belong to exactly one prize tier.
The number of winners in each tier must match the prize table printed in the official file.
First and second prize numbers must match across every source that has them.
Every file we read is stored with its SHA-256 fingerprint and the time we fetched it, and linked from the draw page.

status.text: At least two independent sources agree on the first and second prizes, or the result comes from an official file published after 2019.
The result comes from a single source and passed every check.
Sources disagree. The page shows the conflict and both versions until it is resolved.
A market rate published by a named association or authority.
A market rate we calculate from the international spot price, the exchange rate and the metal purity. It can differ from what your jeweller quotes.

data.crawler: BondCheck fetches public pages slowly, at most one request every two seconds per site, identifies itself as BondCheckBot and respects robots.txt. Files that have not changed are never downloaded again.

fx.how: Reference rates for over 160 currencies, used by the converter and the charts. Twice a day.

privacy.metaDescription: Exactly what BondCheck stores, why, and how to delete it.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: BondCheck works without an account. We store as little as we can, and you can delete all of it yourself at any time.

sections.heading: What we store when you keep a bond list
items: A hashed copy of the secret key held by your browser or phone. We cannot read the key itself.
A hashed copy of your current sync code, used to move your list to another device.
The bonds you add: denomination, number and an optional label you type.
Wins and near misses we find for those bonds, and whether you have seen them.
Your language and time zone, so reminders arrive at a sensible hour.
If you turn on notifications: the push address your browser or phone gives us.

sections.heading: What we never store
items: Your name, phone number, email address or CNIC.
Your IP address, location or device details. Rate limits use a one-way hash that cannot be turned back into an address.
The numbers you check without adding them to a list. Quick checks are not logged.

sections.heading: Cookies and analytics
items: One strictly necessary cookie keeps your bond list connected to your browser. It is not used for anything else.
Your language choice and light or dark theme are remembered in your browser.
We count page views with a cookieless analytics service. It does not identify you or follow you across sites.

sections.heading: Deleting your data
items: Open My bonds, then Settings, then Delete wallet. Your bonds, wins, sync codes and push addresses are removed from our database at once.
Clearing your browser data removes the copy kept on your device.

sections.heading: Where data is kept
items: Data is stored with our hosting and database providers on servers that may be outside Pakistan, encrypted in transit.

privacy.manageLink: Export or delete your wallet in My bonds settings

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: By using BondCheck you agree to these terms. They are short, so please read them.

sections.heading: Information only
paragraphs: BondCheck shows prize bond results and market rates for information. We check results carefully, but sources can contain mistakes and pages can be out of date. Only National Savings Pakistan can confirm a prize, and only it and authorised bank branches pay prizes.

sections.heading: Market rates
paragraphs: Gold, metal and currency figures may be delayed. Figures labelled Estimated are calculated by us and are not a quote from any dealer. Do not rely on them for trading or for any decision with financial consequences.

sections.heading: Your bond list
paragraphs: Keep your sync code private: anyone who has it can open your list. If you lose every device and the sync code, we cannot recover the list for you, because we do not know who you are.

sections.heading: Fair use
paragraphs: Do not overload the service, scrape it in bulk or try to access other people's lists. We may limit or block traffic that does.

sections.heading: No warranty
paragraphs: The service is provided as it is, without any warranty. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for losses that come from using it or from a result that turns out to be wrong.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: We may update these terms. The date at the top of this page shows when they last changed.
